title.zh: OKX完成250亿美元估值融资，Circle、Ripple、SC Ventures等参投
title.en: OKX Raises Fresh Funding at $25 Billion Valuation; Circle, Ripple and SC Ventures Join

current_state.zh: OKX 已在 250 亿美元估值完成新一轮融资，投资方包括 Circle、Ripple、SC Ventures 和 QRT；该轮扩展其 3 月由 ICE 以约 2 亿美元投资的融资，同估值，融资规模未披露。
current_state.en: OKX has closed a new funding round at a $25 billion valuation with investors including Circle, Ripple, SC Ventures and QRT; the round extends its March raise backed by ICE, which invested about $200 million at the same valuation, and the round size was not disclosed.
